exactText: I think that overall, 10 years should otherwise be a very bullish timeline for AGI, it's only in contrast to present hype that it doesn't feel that way.
sourceQuote: 10 years should otherwise be a very bullish timeline for AGI
normalizedClaim: A 10-year timeline to AGI (around 2035) is a bullish / optimistic forecast.
resolutionCriteria: Whether AGI (system preferred for arbitrary jobs over a human) is widely acknowledged as achieved by end of 2035, per major lab claims and independent evaluations.

exactText: We're at this intermediate stage. The models are amazing. They still need a lot of work.
normalizedClaim: Current AI models are in an intermediate stage of development and still require substantial further work before AGI.
resolutionCriteria: Continued existence of major unsolved limitations (continual learning, reliable long-horizon agency, etc.) in frontier models through at least 2028, as documented in technical literature and lab reports.

exactText: in my mind, this is more accurately described as the decade of agents.
sourceQuote: this is more accurately described as the decade of agents.
normalizedClaim: The period from roughly 2025–2035 will be the decade of agents rather than a single “year of agents.”
resolutionCriteria: Sustained major progress and widespread practical use of AI agents across the 2025–2035 decade, with significant remaining limitations early in the period, as reflected in industry adoption metrics and technical reviews.

exactText: It will take about a decade to work through all of those issues.
sourceQuote: It will take about a decade to work through all of those issues.
normalizedClaim: Resolving the key remaining deficits of current models (continual learning, cognitive limitations, etc.) will take about a decade.
resolutionCriteria: Whether core issues such as reliable continual learning and robust long-term memory in frontier models are substantially solved by ~2035.

exactText: Overall, the models are not there. I feel like the industry is making too big of a jump and is trying to pretend like this is amazing, and it’s not. It’s slop.
sourceQuote: Overall, the models are not there.
normalizedClaim: Current frontier models fall short of the capabilities being claimed or implied by much of the industry.
resolutionCriteria: Gap between marketed agentic capabilities and real-world reliability remaining large through 2027–2028, as measured by independent evaluations and user reports.

exactText: my AI timelines are about 5-10X pessimistic w.r.t. what you'll find in your neighborhood SF AI house party or on your twitter timeline, but still quite optimistic w.r.t. a rising tide of AI deniers and skeptics.
sourceQuote: my AI timelines are about 5-10X pessimistic w.r.t. what you'll find in your neighborhood SF AI house party or on your twitter timeline
normalizedClaim: Karpathy’s AGI timeline is 5–10 times more pessimistic than typical Silicon Valley / Twitter hype timelines.
resolutionCriteria: Comparison of realized AGI arrival date (if any by 2035) against the distribution of 2025 SF/Twitter consensus forecasts versus Karpathy’s stated decade-scale view.

exactText: AGI will just blend into the previous ~2.5 centuries of 2% GDP growth
sourceQuote: AGI will just blend into the previous ~2.5 centuries of 2% GDP growth
normalizedClaim: The arrival of AGI will not produce a sharp discontinuity in global GDP growth rates but will blend into the long-term ~2% trend.
resolutionCriteria: Global real GDP growth rates remaining in the historical 1.5–3% range in the decade following widely acknowledged AGI, per World Bank / IMF data.

exactText: I'm very unimpressed by demos. Whenever I see demos of anything, I'm extremely unimpressed by that.
normalizedClaim: Polished AI demos systematically overstate real-world capability and should not be taken as evidence of near-term AGI.
resolutionCriteria: Persistent gap between demo performance and deployed reliability of agentic systems remaining evident in independent audits through 2028.

exactText: we'll be working with these things for a decade. They're going to get better, and it's going to be wonderful.
sourceQuote: we'll be working with these things for a decade.
normalizedClaim: Humanity will continue actively developing and working with AI agents throughout the coming decade.
resolutionCriteria: Continued major R&D investment and iterative improvement of agentic systems from 2025 through 2035, with agents remaining imperfect but progressively more useful.

exactText: before we have an entity that you'd prefer to hire over a person for an arbitrary job in the world.
sourceQuote: before we have an entity that you'd prefer to hire over a person for an arbitrary job in the world.
normalizedClaim: True AGI, defined as an entity one would prefer to hire over a human for an arbitrary job, remains years of additional work away.
resolutionCriteria: Whether, by 2035, there exists an AI system that employers broadly prefer to human workers across a wide range of arbitrary knowledge-work jobs, per labor market data and surveys.
